---
title: "Welcome"
---

This documentation provides detail on available options, analysis routines, underlying algorithms and formulas. All file-loading and analysis code is [open source][1] and we are happy to answer questions on implementation and code.

We hope you will find our software a useful tool in your patch-clamp electrophysiology analysis. Please don't hesitate to contact us at [support@easyelectrophysiology.com](mailto:support@easyelectrophysiology.com) with any questions, suggestions or feedback.

The [Easy Electrophysiology license](https://www.easyelectrophysiology.com/license) is available on our website.

Happy Analyzing!

[1]: https://github.com/easy-electrophysiology/easy-electrophysiology-analysis
